local_axes: X east, Y placeholder zero (NOT observed height), Z south; Godot suitable

accuracy.centerline: Community OSM geometry; not survey-certified. No numerical positional guarantee. Some source tags YahooJapan/ALPSMAP;GSImaps/std2013 preserved.
accuracy.extent: Approximate screenshot extent; cut near 135.8127E and 135.8690E at nearest existing OSM nodes. Allow several hundred metres endpoint ambiguity; not an exact georeferenced screenshot crop.
accuracy.elevation: Unverified, all null. Zero local Y is a placeholder, never label actual road elevation.
accuracy.bridges: OSM bridge flags preserved, potentially incomplete. Never drape bridges to terrain DEM.
accuracy.width: OSM tags generally two lanes; physical width/banking unverified.

implementation: Keep vehicle physics and existing courses. Add separate approximate-real-plan course. Preserve metre scale, do not force to 5km. Use null/explicit temporary elevation until road-deck profile verified. Google screenshot used only to understand desired extent, no pixels/textures or traced road geometry included.
